versions.title: Locked weekly snapshots
versions.summary: After Sunday 11:30 pm the app saves one insert-only record per task for that week, so deleting a task keeps its history. Bonus all-time counts keep deleted tickets. Scores, reel, breakdown and print read locked weeks from their records. Database step: supabase/week_task_snapshots_migration.sql (to-do T15); no locking happens until it runs. Family Habits PR #12.

lessons: Editing a task in place rewrites every past week that uses it. Keep dated history from the start: a change takes effect from the next week, and a week is locked once it ends.
A seed date that is too early makes tasks count in weeks before they existed. Seed each history row from the date the task really started, and check the result against the creation dates.
Keep history separate from the rows it describes. Deleting a task cascades to its completions, so a deleted task erased its past weeks. A snapshot with no foreign key survives the delete.
Test scoring with the real functions, not copies. A small harness that loads the functions from app.js, with a fake clock and database, caught a wrong start date and a test with the wrong week.

Database steps that need an answer can stall. The Supabase migration tool timed out with an unanswered question four times, so the schema change was not applied. Run schema changes in the SQL editor, or answer the prompt right away, and check the table exists afterwards.
